proposed.text: In SPP 202 work-suspended-or-abandoned wording, once the architect has prepared the plans, specifications, and other building construction documents, that completed work is equivalent to what share of the architect's work?
proposed.rationale: SPP 202 states that when the detailed design and contract documents are prepared, that phase is equivalent to ninety percent of the architect's work in the abandonment context.
proposed.explanation: Use 90% when the question is testing SPP 202 work-suspended-or-abandoned wording. Keep that distinct from UAP Document 401-402 payment milestones, where Contract Documents increase cumulative payment to 85% of the Basic Fee.
